_meta.description: Hotel loyalty programmes and the rupee value of their points. nightlyCashByRegion is the representative paid rate (INR/night) used to estimate redemption value. Illustrative, reviewed May 2026.

programs.name: Marriott Bonvoy
programs.highlight: Largest footprint in India; 5th-night-free on points and broad airline transfers.

programs.name: Hilton Honors
programs.highlight: Lots of points per stay and strong 5th-night-free value at resorts.

programs.name: IHG One Rewards
programs.highlight: 4th-night-free for members and good availability across India and SE Asia.

programs.name: World of Hyatt
programs.highlight: The most valuable hotel point — outsized value at luxury properties.
